TrendsAccuracyParamsSchema (target, display_date, limit; no country/device_type) forwarded to getTrafficAccuracy() as query values against TRENDS_API_BASE_URL + 'accuracy'. Caller-controlled value is placed only in the axios `params` object (a query-string VALUE) against a hardcoded Semrush base-URL constant; hostname/path are never built from caller input, and the API key is attached server-side in buildRequestParts(), never by the caller.

CheckParamsSchema (EmptyParamsSchema, zod z.object({})) — the handler takes no destructured fields and calls semrushApi.listProjects() with an empty params object; no caller-controlled input reaches any sink.

CheckParamsSchema (EmptyParamsSchema) — the handler takes no arguments and calls semrushApi.getApiUnitsBalance(), which hits the hardcoded https://www.semrush.com/users/countapiunits.html URL with an empty params object; no caller-controlled input exists.

ProjectIdParamsSchema (project_id: z.number().positive()) forwarded to getProject(projectId), which builds `${PROJECTS_API_BASE_URL}/${projectId}`. project_id is zod-validated as a positive number before the handler ever runs, so it cannot contain '/', '..' or any character that would alter the path structure on the fixed semrush.com host — this is the caller's own project under their own API key, not a path-traversal or SSRF vector.

ProjectIdParamsSchema (project_id: z.number().positive()) forwarded to deleteProject(projectId) -> DELETE `${PROJECTS_API_BASE_URL}/${projectId}`. project_id is numeric-only per zod schema (no injection into the path), and the operation is scoped to whichever Semrush account owns the configured API key — it can only delete that account's own project, matching the remote-api-wrapper pattern (destructive but on the caller's own resource), not a missing-authorization bug in this server.

ProjectIdParamsSchema (project_id: z.number().positive()) forwarded to getSiteAuditIssues(projectId) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/meta/issues`; project_id is numeric-only per zod, no path injection possible.

SiteAuditInfoParamsSchema (= ProjectIdParamsSchema, project_id numeric) forwarded to getSiteAuditInfo(projectId) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/info`; project_id is zod-validated as a positive number, no path injection possible.

SiteAuditSnapshotsParamsSchema (= ProjectIdParamsSchema, project_id numeric) forwarded to getSiteAuditSnapshots(projectId) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/snapshots`; project_id is zod-validated numeric, no path injection possible.

SiteAuditLaunchParamsSchema (= ProjectIdParamsSchema, project_id numeric) forwarded to launchSiteAuditCrawl(projectId), a POST to `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/launch`; project_id is zod-validated numeric, the crawl only runs against the caller's own project as registered in their Semrush account, no arbitrary-target crawl is possible from this parameter.

ProjectCreateParamsSchema (url, project_name?) forwarded to createProject(url, projectName) -> POST to the fixed PROJECTS_API_BASE_URL with `url`/`project_name` sent as POST body fields (buildRequestParts sends body data for post/put), never concatenated into the request URL itself. Caller-controlled value is placed only in the axios `params` object (a query-string VALUE) against a hardcoded Semrush base-URL constant; hostname/path are never built from caller input, and the API key is attached server-side in buildRequestParts(), never by the caller.

ProjectUpdateParamsSchema (project_id numeric, project_name) forwarded to updateProject(projectId, projectName) -> PUT to the fixed PROJECTS_API_BASE_URL with project_id/project_name sent as body fields, not part of the URL/hostname.

SiteAuditSnapshotDetailParamsSchema (project_id, snapshot_id, both z.number().positive()) forwarded to getSiteAuditSnapshotDetail(projectId, snapshotId) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/snapshot` with snapshot_id sent as a query param value; both IDs are zod-validated numeric, no path injection possible.

SiteAuditPagesParamsSchema (project_id numeric, url string, limit, page) forwarded to getSiteAuditPages(projectId, url, limit, page) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/page/list` with `url` sent only as a query-param filter value (no local file read/write of crawl data occurs anywhere in index.ts/semrush-api.ts — response is JSON.stringify'd straight back to the MCP client via successResponse()); project_id is zod-numeric.

SiteAuditPageDetailParamsSchema (project_id, page_id, both z.number().positive()) forwarded to getSiteAuditPageDetail(projectId, pageId) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/page/${pageId}`; both IDs are zod-validated numeric, no path injection possible, and no local file is written or read.

SiteAuditHistoryParamsSchema (project_id numeric, limit, offset) forwarded to getSiteAuditHistory(projectId, limit, offset) -> `${SITE_AUDIT_REPORTS_BASE_URL}/${projectId}/siteaudit/history` with limit/offset as query values; project_id is zod-validated numeric, no path injection possible.
